concept.title: Types of Incidents
concept.shortdesc: Possible incidents that need to be reported.

conbody.p: This page explains how anyone in the campus community can report a suspected cybersecurity incident, which can involve one or more of the following types:
Potential unauthorized disclosure or alteration of:

ul.li: University data that is not routinely made available to the general public; for example, employee evaluations.
Data that the university is legally or contractually bound to protect, such as social security numbers, credit card numbers, or certain research data.

conbody.p: Loss or theft of computers, electronic storage devices or media containing any of the following:

ul.li: University data that is not routinely made available to the general public.
Data that the university is legally or contractually bound to protect.

conbody.p: Inappropriate content on a university web page, whether accessed directly or via pop-up:

ul.li: Advertising for a non-educational commercial product; for example, an online pharmacy

conbody.p: Distribution of viruses or malicious software from a device or computer on the university network
